name: New Year Celebrations!
label: Quest
description: New Year Celebrations!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year! All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!
It should be pretty nice... But Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!
Well anyway, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers. Can you do me a favor and deliver it!
Thanks, friend! Innkeeper Pala is in the inn near the bridge to Hunter's Rise.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Good day, adventurer! Did you come to Thunder Bluff for our celebrations? Or are you here to rest a weary hoof between hunts?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, very good! These supplies will help feed all our people, here to celebrate the new year!
I thank you, friend. You are in my debt. Please, take these coins... And heed my advice - drink heartily from the kegs outside, and join our revelers in a dance of celebration!
